shared.evidence_format: complete parallel XCTest progress inventory; later successful set-e build phases prove command completion

plus.evidence_format: complete parallel XCTest progress inventory; later successful set-e build phases prove command completion

native.evidence_format: individual hosted XCTest started+passed lines and two matching summaries

sdk.swift:
Apple Swift version 6.3.3 (swiftlang-6.3.3.1.3 clang-2100.1.1.101)
Target: arm64-apple-macosx26.0

idle.scope: Owned application process only. RSS excludes WindowServer, GPU allocations and other processes. This is runner idle-launch evidence, not physical Finder/notch performance.

previews.scope: Actual stored native renders; source-defined fixtures are not live accounts/hardware. Visual clipping/readability still needs manual review.

public_services.native_decoding_evidence: all five source-declared PublicServiceEvaluationTests individually passed

limitations: Native hosted tests and source-defined fixtures are not interactive Finder/notch/hardware/account acceptance.
Parallel Core test logs contain complete Testing records, not separate individual passed lines.
PNG structure/content checks do not establish clipping, keyboard/VoiceOver behavior or readability.
